progress_update.summary: We refactored the handler name resolution system from a runtime closure on ContextInternal to a trait-based design using NameResolution<S> + NamedService. Introduced a #[restate_sdk::completion] macro that bridges concrete types to their resolvers. Also introduced ServiceClient/KeyedClient trait hierarchy (backported to PR #100), made unlink async, and rebased linked-services on client-macro with upstream main merged.
progress_update.goal: Linked workflows feature for Restate Rust SDK — parent-child service linking with typed completion handlers, promise objects, and compile-time safety enforcement
accomplished: Introduced ServiceClient trait with SERVICE_NAME const, KeyedClient hierarchy, backported to PR #100 (client-macro branch)
Replaced runtime HandlerResolver closure with trait-based NameResolution<S> + NamedService design — no runtime state on ContextInternal
Added #[restate_sdk::completion] proc macro that generates NamedService impl connecting concrete types to their resolver
Made unlink async — properly awaits sys_unlink_service NotificationHandle instead of discarding it
Rebased linked-services on client-macro (which includes upstream main merge), all tests passing via just verify
progress_update.now: Session ended after implementing async unlink. User confirmed next step is implementing link_object (sys_link_service syscall for linking to already-running objects).
next_steps: Decide final name for #[restate_sdk::completion] macro (alternatives: linked, handlers, object_impl)
Consider implementing the type_name full-string matching (strip_prefix approach from prototype) vs current rsplit approach
Commit async unlink changes and run sweep
constraints: Orphan rules prevent blanket impl<T: Trait> NameResolution for T — requires #[completion] macro bridge
type_name format not guaranteed by Rust spec but stable in practice for function items
NameResolution only generated for Object service types currently, not workflows
decisions: NameResolution<S> trait on per-service resolver struct (orphan-safe) + NamedService associated type to connect concrete types
resolve() returns &'static str (infallible) with unreachable!() guard — CompletionHandlerFnT guarantees correctness
NamedService not a supertrait — only bound on on_completion, so #[completion] only needed when using on_completion
ServiceClient::SERVICE_NAME as const &'static str, KeyedClient for keyed services, IntoObjectClient/IntoWorkflowClient as markers
unlink is async, awaits NotificationHandle from sys_unlink_service
open_questions: Should NameResolution also be generated for Workflow service types?
risks: type_name format could change in future Rust versions — mitigated by prototype test validation
